fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is the only viable bounded mutation, but it is incomplete as written: non-antipodal legal points generally leave an affine family of possible sphere centers, so “each feasible common sphere” is not a finite specification. Empty-shell feasibility must be solved over the complete exact center polyhedron, and a local Delaunay shell alone does not prove finite transfer closure or separation outside K.

Proposal 2 audits only bounded witnesses with coordinates in [-2,2], omits a complete COPY tile, and gives no terminating global CVP separation procedure. Pairwise mod-2 distinction removes integral chord midpoints but does not remove G13-style affine combinations, while an exact Farkas certificate is not justified for the strict positive-definite feasibility problem.

Proposal 3 does not specify how syndrome congruences and quotient ports become ordinary emitted integral equality rows with charged carries. Its experiment covers NAND labelings but not a complete NAND/COPY glued transfer system, and code distance cannot distinguish harmful states occupying the same coset.

Proposal 4 misapplies quaternion norm multiplicativity to unrestricted signed selector couplings, which live in a free selector module rather than as single products in a division order. Zero or unintended-unit aggregates can remain cheap, and the proposed first-shell enumeration lacks a specified NAND/COPY codebook, control, closure test, and 65/64 comparison.

Proposal 5's finite enumeration of small M-matrices cannot establish the claimed symbolic no-go theorem, especially the asserted coverage of all Voronoi-first-kind encodings. It tests no current frontier candidate and therefore cannot discriminate the tile lemma.

Proposal 6 is analysis tooling, not a tile mechanism. Recomputing G28's already verified non-growth supplies no new frontier evidence, while analyzing a surviving non-antipodal table is properly a stage of Proposal 1 and still requires an independent outside-K certificate.

Proposal 7 supplies no explicit integral lift matrices, defect quotient, target, objective, or finite search family; Witt, Teichmuller, Verschiebung, and mapping-cone terminology does not define an executable CVP construction. SNF on two unspecified levels of one nine-clause instance could not establish the honest-preserving prime-lift lemma.
evidence: ROADMAP's current frontier requires fixed NAND and COPY tiles, complete unrestricted transfer closure, exact outside-K coercivity, and lambda/mu at least 65/64. None of Proposals 2–7 specifies a bounded experiment checking all of these requirements.

The Generation-3 verifier exactly rejected 2,924,544 antipodal D4 candidates using center-independent interior midpoints, with deficits 3/4 and 17/4. ROADMAP and SOL_RESULT explicitly state that non-antipodal D4 codebooks remain untested, so Proposal 1 genuinely escapes the proved obstruction without claiming success.

The retained 952 positive-definite Gram parameters are verified evidence only about the frozen rational Gram grid. There is no verifier evidence that any non-antipodal labeling is cospherical, empty, closed under composition, or has favorable growth.

Existing verified attacks show that bounded named-state audits are inadequate: G13 affine collision, G19 signed splicing, G28 non-growth, and G32/G37 additive parity all survive apparently strong local checks. Proposal 1 is acceptable only with complete lattice and transfer enumeration, not midpoint sampling.
No supplied result proves a hardness lemma, recursive shell theorem, dimension-dependent gap, or asymptotic claim; all positive evidence remains finite.
next_experiment: Run only a repaired non-antipodal D4 gate. Over the same lattice, six triality-class assignments, 952 verified Gram parameters, and every ordered distinct non-antipodal Boolean pair, first deduplicate by a machine-checked exact symmetry map; then compute the complete Voronoi-relevant constraint set for each fixed Gram and solve exactly for every center making all legal NAND or COPY points equidistant and no other lattice point weakly closer. Reject unless both tiles have exact empty-shell certificates; for survivors, emit complete gluing rows, derive a finite K with an exact outside-K bound, and compute unrestricted depth-two legal and adverse minima by exact Fincke–Pohst enumeration. Continue the D4 direction only if closure holds and lambda/mu >= 65/64; otherwise kill it.
